output.question: How many employees does Coca-Cola have?
output.answer: The Coca-Cola Company reported approximately 65,900 employees worldwide as of December 31, 2025. This is the latest reported headcount I could verify as of November 11, 2026. ([investors.coca-colacompany.com](https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/filings-reports/all-sec-filings/content/0001628280-26-010047/ko-20251231.htm))
